basic_attack.description: one basic attack; crit behavior follows the combatant's crit_mode

generic_slot_actions.description: cast by slot ({"type": "active", "slot": "Q"}); damage follows the champion's per-slot formula at the combatant's validated ability rank

actions.champion_actions_field: per-champion supported active_name values are listed on each champions[] entry
actions.validation_note: active_name validation at execution time is runtime-based: names listed here are supported; an unlisted name is not guaranteed to fail but a kernel-rejected action appears in the trace as action_failed under the plan's on_failure policy and is still billed

build_options.starting_hp: optional; any finite value > 0, defaults to the champion's computed max HP

targeting_policies.description: explicit ordered priority list of enemy runtime IDs; first living entry is the target; idles if none listed is alive
first living enemy in scenario slot order
living enemy with the lowest current HP
living enemy with the lowest current HP fraction

targeting_tie_break: equal values break to the lower scenario slot index

not_before.description: absolute scenario time (seconds) before which the step is not eligible

action_plan_options.plan_exhaustion: a non-repeating plan past its last step idles for the rest of the scenario

descriptions.summary: actions, failures, target changes, deaths, plan transitions and termination; per-action damage and healing totals included, kernel breakdown omitted
descriptions.standard: every event family, with the kernel's damage-pipeline intermediates removed and identical magnitude-free kernel events folded into one row carrying a repeat count
descriptions.calculation: everything `standard` returns, plus the evidence a calculation inspector needs: the damage pipeline stage by stage (raw, mitigation, amps, flat reduction, shield, applied HP), the defences the mitigation used, and each ability's formula text with the value every identifier in it resolved to
descriptions.full: the complete diagnostic trace, unmodified; larger payloads

billing.idempotency_request_matching: the stored request is matched by a digest of the validated request; resend the identical body to replay, and prefer re-sending the exact bytes rather than re-serializing

recovery.note: records created before this contract existed carry no team_shape and no champions; they are listed with those fields null rather than inferred

execution_assumptions.same_timestamp_actions: sequential in scenario slot order, never simultaneous
execution_assumptions.retry_warning: recovering a lost response is safe ONLY by resending the identical request with the SAME Idempotency-Key; any other resend is a new billable simulation
execution_assumptions.scope_attribution: explicit non-empty scope_attribution mappings are rejected; scoped pools belong to the action's primary target

unsupported_mechanics: simultaneous same-timestamp resolution (equal times run sequentially in scenario slot order)
combat AI or optimal-action selection (plans and targeting are explicit caller input)
full crowd-control simulation (stuns/roots/displacements as time denial)
summons, pets, clones, minions, jungle monsters, turrets, objectives, experience, or routing
cross-champion secondary-scope attribution (scoped pools belong to the action's primary target; explicit non-empty mappings are rejected)
teams larger than 5 combatants (product cap; 1v1 through 5v5 are supported)
